tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every welldun page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the article sheet, menus, inputs and secondary buttons. Sits on surface with a line border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code, table header rows and wells set into surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkbox outlines, the secondary button on hover. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: deks, captions, metadata, nav links at rest. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand accent (a lit line lamp). Primary buttons, the wordmark dot, eyebrows, links, focus rings. As text, on surface and surface-raised only.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and signal-coloured text on signal-soft or surface-sunken.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds behind signal-strong text: the accent badge, selected nav item, highlighted table row.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal or signal-strong fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. An alias of signal, at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text, underlined. An alias of signal.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block ground. Dark in both themes, so code reads the same everywhere.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, prompts' trailing output and line numbers on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-signal
tokens.usage: The shell prompt, strings and the active tab marker on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Code block edge. Invisible in light (same as code-bg); in dark it keeps the block from melting into surface.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Call state queued: text and dot, on status-queued-soft, surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: status-queued-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for queued.

tokens.name: status-dialing
tokens.usage: Call state dialing (ochre, kept apart from signal): text and dot, on status-dialing-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: status-dialing-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for dialing.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Call state in_progress (a live call): text and dot, on status-live-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: status-live-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for in_progress.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Call state completed and other success: text and dot, on status-done-soft or the surfaces. Blue-leaning on purpose so it never relies on red/green hue against failed.

tokens.name: status-done-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for completed.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Call state failed and errors: text and dot, on status-failed-soft or the surfaces. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Pill ground for failed; error callouts.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: AI phone calls you can run yourself.
styles.usage: One per page: the product or home hero headline. Drop to display-lg under 720px.

styles.name: display-md
styles.sample: The phone part is the hard part
styles.usage: Page section headings on marketing pages; article titles on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: h2 inside articles and docs; card titles that need weight.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: h3 in articles, product card names, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech over a real phone line.
styles.usage: Ledes and article deks, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every time the caller finishes speaking, the agent runs a relay race.
styles.usage: Article and docs running text. Keep lines near 68 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Set VOICE_DEBUG_LOGGING=1 to log per-stage latency.
styles.usage: Captions, card descriptions, footers, table cells.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, tabs, form labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a headline, in signal. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase table headers and metadata labels, in ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers that line up: latencies, IDs, phone numbers, call states. Use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, the dot inside a status pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills, buttons in a row, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (vertical x horizontal 8 x 14 uses space-2 / 14px), gaps in nav.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between paragraphs and blocks in an article.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between a headline group and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap before an article h2; between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges, table header wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the article sheet, code blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the status dot only.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows are rare. Raised elements use a line border; only floating layers (menus, popovers, the sticky header once scrolled) get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the copied toast, the sticky header after scroll.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text in articles and docs.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content, gutters excluded.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at the default size; 32px at sm.
